Subject: Shiny app not resizing properly for mobile

I have a shiny app that is using navbarPage for it's ui layout. The app displays as I would expect when I resize it in a browser on my computer, where it reorients itself based on how large the window is, but it does not display properly on a mobile device, i.e. it displays the way it would in a full size browser window. 

Here's is a link to my app: https://smking.shinyapps.io/deploy

I have noticed that if I go to the link https://internal.shinyapps.io/smking/deploy on my phone that it displays the way I would like it to. 

How can I get it to display properly on a mobile device?
